decisions.reason: Locates all reads; prescribes temporary chat.legacy projection via useChat/views.get('chat')?.legacy for partial/runningCalls/turnEnds with later migration to the owning timeline API.
States running belongs to useSession lifecycle immediately, is not part of chat legacy, and the existing useSession call needs no rename.

Covers the scoped registration region, explains renderer-owned slots declaration and augmentation/service ownership, and preserves slot name and registration ordering/lifetime.

Ties reads to full DSH-0.1.2-A1-03 (field note naming partial/runningCalls/turnEnds, excluding running) plus A1-25 package removal, and separates staged projection from immediate lifecycle/type/inject changes.
